mechanics.claim: A Frozen Thrall spawns only when an enemy champion dies while Lissandra is nearby, from that champion's corpse.
mechanics.quote: Whenever a nearby enemy champion dies, '''Lissandra''' spawns a ''Frozen Thrall'' from their corpse.

mechanics.claim: Thralls are invulnerable and untargetable, so they cannot be damaged or targeted in either fight.
The thrall chases visible enemies for 4 seconds then shatters to deal magic damage to nearby enemies, a separate damage instance from other abilities.
